summary: Strengthen reports, proposals, and executive summaries with practical tools, templates, and editing techniques. Enrol now.
lede: Report and proposal writing helps professionals turn evidence into clear documents that support review and decisions. It is designed for people preparing business cases, reports, proposals, and briefings for approval or action. Participants practice structuring arguments around evidence, drafting executive summaries and recommendations, and improving readability through clear formatting and focused editing.
audienceIntro: This advanced report and proposal writing course is designed for professionals who must produce high-stakes documents that influence decisions, secure approvals, and communicate results with precision.
prerequisites: You should have working experience writing workplace documents, emails, memos, reports, or proposal sections. Familiarity with Microsoft Word and a basic understanding of project or programme work will help you move faster through the writing exercises. No coding is required, but you should come prepared with a laptop and one example of a report or proposal from your current work for review and improvement.
